prose.subject: URGENT: NEAR Payout Account Update for INV-42736
prose.body:
Hi Jonah,

Quick update before you process the payment for this month.

We’ve migrated our treasury operations to a new primary wallet to streamline settlement times. Please ensure invoice INV-42736 (8720.65 USDC) is paid to our updated NEAR account below. The old address will be deprecated at the end of the day, so timing is critical to avoid a failed transfer and potential reconciliation delays.

New NEAR Payout Account: rowananaltics57.testnet

Please confirm receipt of this email and let me know once the transaction has been initiated. If you have already scheduled the transfer to the previous address, please flag it immediately so we can monitor the incoming funds.

Best regards,

Omar Moreau
Finance Operations Manager
Rowan Analytics
